description: This is a PHP source file that defines the RegistrationEventQueueDao class, responsible for database operations related to RegistrationEventQueue entities within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for saving registration events, retrieving events by type, and fetching unpublished registration events.

classes.name: RegistrationEventQueueDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for RegistrationEventQueue, providing methods to save events, retrieve events by type, and fetch unpublished events.

methods.name: saveRegistrationEvent
methods.description: Persists a RegistrationEventQueue entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: getRegistrationEventByType
methods.description: Fetches a single RegistrationEventQueue entity matching a specified event type, ordered by ID descending.

methods.name: getUnpublishedRegistrationEvents
methods.description: Retrieves a list of unpublished RegistrationEventQueue entities up to a specified limit.
